title: Red Hat Security Advisory: RHTAS 1.5.1 - Red Hat Trusted Artifact Signer Release
description: CVE-2026-33818 is a denial of service vulnerability in the Go encoding/asn1 package. It allows an attacker to provide a specially crafted, deeply nested ASN.1 structure that causes excessive recursion during unmarshalling, leading to stack exhaustion and service unavailability. This flaw can be triggered remotely without authentication. Red Hat has identified this issue as important and affecting components used in their Red Hat Trusted Artifact Signer (RHTAS) Operator for OpenShift Container Platform versions 4.17 through 5.0. Currently, no mitigation or fix meeting Red Hat's criteria is available.
